methodologyNotes: Published self-serve pricing for project-management / work-management software (Asana, Monday.com, ClickUp, Wrike, Trello, Notion, Airtable, Basecamp) was collected from each vendor's public pricing page on the accessedAt date and normalized to USD. Where a vendor prices per seat/user, monthlyUsd records the per-seat list price (billingModel per_seat) at the annual-billing rate, with the month-to-month rate noted in the plan notes; flat-priced tiers record the flat monthly fee (billingModel flat). Quote-only / contact-sales / Enterprise tiers carry a null price rather than an estimate. These are not telephony products, so minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin and overagePerCall are null on every plan, and HIPAA/BAA/bilingual are null unless a vendor states otherwise. Every figure is sourced to the vendor pricing page on the accessed date with an independent corroborating source attached where one confirmed the figure.

vendors.name: Asana
vendors.provenance: Prices read from asana.com/pricing on 2026-06-13; per-user/month rates corroborated by buyersprint.com Asana 2026 pricing breakdown.

plans.name: Personal
plans.notes: Free forever for up to 2 users: unlimited tasks/projects, list/board/calendar views, 100+ integrations, 100MB per-file storage cap. Limited to 2 users.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: $10.99/user/mo at annual-billing rate; month-to-month rate $13.49/user/mo. Adds timeline & Gantt, reporting dashboards, unlimited automations, forms, custom fields, AI Studio Basic (50K credits/mo), unlimited free guests.

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: $24.99/user/mo at annual-billing rate; month-to-month rate $30.49/user/mo. Adds unlimited portfolios, goals, workload management, approvals & proofing, time tracking, formulas, Salesforce/Tableau/Power BI, AI Studio Basic (75K credits/mo).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact-sales / custom pricing. Adds SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning, universal workload, capacity planning, service accounts, admin controls, AI Studio Basic (200K credits/mo). Enterprise+ tier available for enhanced security/compliance.

vendors.name: monday.com
vendors.provenance: Work Management plan prices read from monday.com/pricing on 2026-06-13. Official page rendered EUR (€0/€9/€12/€19) due to geo; US per-seat USD list ($9/$12/$19, same numerals) corroborated by 2026 third-party pricing roundups (costbench, plaky).

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free forever for up to 2 seats (Work Management): up to 3 boards, 3 docs, 200+ templates, 8 column types, iOS/Android apps.

plans.name: Basic
plans.notes: $9/seat/mo annual-billing rate; month-to-month $12/seat/mo. Paid plans carry a 3-seat minimum (official calculator may show 10-seat default). Unlimited viewers, unlimited items, basic AI (1,000 credits/mo).

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $12/seat/mo annual-billing rate; month-to-month $14/seat/mo. 3-seat minimum. Adds timeline/Gantt & calendar views, guest access, 250 automations & 250 integration actions/mo, advanced AI (2,000 credits/mo).

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $19/seat/mo annual-billing rate; month-to-month $24/seat/mo. 3-seat minimum. Adds private boards/docs, time tracking, advanced board views & columns, 25,000 automations & integration actions/mo, premium AI (3,000 credits/mo).

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact-sales / custom pricing. Adds enterprise security & governance, portfolio & resource management, multi-level permissions, enterprise support, 20,000 AI credits/mo.

vendors.name: ClickUp
vendors.provenance: Prices read from clickup.com/pricing on 2026-06-13 (annual rates shown on page); monthly-billing rates corroborated by costbench 2026 ClickUp breakdown. HIPAA availability stated on Enterprise tier.

plans.name: Free Forever
plans.notes: Free forever: unlimited tasks, unlimited free members, 60MB storage, collaborative docs, kanban boards, sprint management, calendar view, 2FA, 1 form.

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.notes: $7/user/mo annual-billing rate; month-to-month $10/user/mo. Unlimited storage/spaces/folders/forms/integrations, unlimited Gantt, native time tracking, goals & portfolios, resource management, guest permissions.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $12/user/mo annual-billing rate; month-to-month $19/user/mo. Adds unlimited dashboards, 5K automations/mo, webhooks, mind maps, private whiteboards, sprint points & reporting, portfolio workload, Google SSO.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact-sales / custom quote. Adds SAML SSO & SCIM, enterprise permissions, unlimited custom roles, audit log, 250K automations/mo, custom branding, MSA & HIPAA availability, data residency, dedicated CSM.

vendors.name: Wrike
vendors.provenance: Prices read from wrike.com/price on 2026-06-13. Page states figures are 'priced per month and billed on an annual per-user basis,' valid for purchases from 2026-01-21.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free for unlimited users: web/desktop/mobile apps, project & task management, board view, table view.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: $10/user/mo, billed annually. Seat range 2-15 users. Adds AI Essentials, shareable dashboards, interactive Gantt charts.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $25/user/mo, billed annually (annual subscription required). Seat range 5-200 users; licenses sold in fixed bands. Adds AI Elite features, workspace templates, standard integrations.

plans.name: Pinnacle
plans.notes: Contact-sales / 'Contact us for pricing'. 5+ users. Adds 3x AI Elite actions, advanced resource planning, budgeting, advanced reporting.

plans.name: Apex
plans.notes: Contact-sales / 'Contact us for pricing'. 5+ users. Top tier: 10x AI Elite actions, unlimited whiteboards, Wrike Integrate, bi-directional integrations.

vendors.name: Trello
vendors.provenance: Prices read from trello.com/pricing on 2026-06-13 (Atlassian product). Per-user/month annual and monthly rates shown on page.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free: unlimited cards, up to 10 boards per Workspace, up to 10 collaborators, unlimited Power-Ups, 250 Workspace command runs/mo, 2FA, 10MB per-file storage.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: $5/user/mo annual-billing rate; month-to-month $6/user/mo. Adds unlimited boards, advanced checklists, custom fields, card mirroring, Planner, 1,000 command runs/mo, 250MB per-file storage.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: $10/user/mo annual-billing rate; month-to-month $12.50/user/mo. Adds Calendar/Timeline/Table/Dashboard/Map views, workspace-level views, unlimited command runs, admin & security controls, AI card features, data export.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: $17.50/user/mo billed annually (~$210/user/year); rate scales by seat band. Adds unlimited Workspaces, org-wide permissions, multi-board guests, Power-Up administration, free SSO & user provisioning via Atlassian Guard.

vendors.name: Notion
vendors.provenance: Prices read from notion.com/pricing on 2026-06-13. Per-seat rates shown ($9.50 Plus / $19.50 Business); page notes 20% annual saving.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free: databases with subtasks/dependencies, basic forms & sites, Notion Calendar & Mail, trial AI. Limits: 5MB file uploads, 7-day page history, 10 external guests, limited blocks for 2+ member workspaces.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: $9.50/member/mo; page states 20% saving with annual billing. Adds custom forms & sites, unlimited charts, unlimited file uploads, basic connections, 30-day page history.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $19.50/member/mo; 20% annual saving. Recommended tier. Adds Notion Agent, AI Meeting Notes, Enterprise Search (beta), SAML SSO, granular database permissions, private teamspaces, premium connections, unlimited guests.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Contact-sales / custom pricing. Adds zero data retention with LLM providers, SCIM user provisioning, advanced security controls, audit logs, CSM, domain management.

vendors.name: Airtable
vendors.provenance: Prices read from airtable.com/pricing on 2026-06-13. Page states Team $20/user/mo and Business $45/user/mo when billed annually; monthly-billing rates not published on the page. HIPAA support offered on Enterprise Scale.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Free for small teams: core building blocks for apps, individual/small-team use. Capacity limited vs paid tiers.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: $20/user/mo billed annually (monthly-billing rate not published on page). More capacity than Free for growing teams.

plans.name: Business
plans.notes: $45/user/mo billed annually (monthly-billing rate not published on page). Adds customization, data scale, flexibility, and administrative features.

plans.name: Enterprise Scale
plans.notes: Contact-sales / custom pricing based on org needs and scale. Unlimited org units, workspaces, and bases within the organization.

vendors.name: Basecamp
vendors.provenance: Prices read from basecamp.com/pricing on 2026-06-13. Basecamp offers a per-user Pro plan and a flat-rate Pro Unlimited plan; both figures shown on page.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Run 1 project free forever: 1 project, 1GB storage, up to 20 users.

plans.name: Pro
plans.notes: $15/user/mo (pay-per-user). Unlimited projects, 500GB storage, all core features, 24/7 support, 30-day trial; guests/clients added free.

plans.name: Pro Unlimited
plans.notes: $299 flat/mo on annual commitment (fixed price, no per-user charges). Unlimited projects & users, 5TB storage, Admin Pro Pack, Timesheet upgrade, personal onboarding, priority 24/7 support, 60-day trial.
